name: Dark Blue
source:
The protagonist, Yukito, is invited to his classmate Reiya's vacation home. He expected to spend a fun summer vacation there with the heroine, Otoha, and his friends... but the story takes a turn following an incident that occurs within the confines of the villa.

[Translated from [url=https://t.vndb.org/cv/47/122447.jpg]The Blue Kiwami package[/url]]
translation:
主人公雪斗受同班同学玲矢之邀，前往对方的度假别墅做客。他原本满心期待能与女主角音羽及好友们在此度过一段愉快的暑假时光……然而随着封闭的洋馆内突发一起事件，事态急转直下。

[译自[url=https://t.vndb.org/cv/47/122447.jpg]《The Blue极》包装盒简介[/url]]
